title: Static model expectations
description: Element-attribute expectations that have no observable runtime effect in a single scenario run (category, candidate starters, exclusive=false, businessCalendarName, ...). Checked against the BpmnModel the engine parsed from the deployed resources and, for candidate starters, against the process definition's identity links (docs/adr/0005-scenario-format.md, docs/user-guide/scenarios.md).

expected.description: Same value language as scenario files: a literal means equals; an object whose keys all start with '$' is a matcher ($exists, $type, $regex, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $contains, $size, $any, $ignore). Objects compare the listed properties of the model bean only; arrays compare element by element. The pseudo property '@class' yields the simple class name of a bean.

attributes.description: Bean property name of the Activiti BpmnModel class (e.g. category, businessCalendarName, candidateGroups, executionListeners) -> expected value. The aliases 'exclusive' (inverse of notExclusive) and 'async' (asynchronous) are also understood.

definition.description: Properties of the deployed process definition (org.activiti.engine.repository.ProcessDefinition): name, description, category (the targetNamespace of the definitions), version, suspended, ...

process.description: Properties of the parsed org.activiti.bpmn.model.Process: name, documentation, executable, candidateStarterUsers, candidateStarterGroups, executionListeners, eventListeners, dataObjects, ...

candidateStarters.description: Candidate starters read from the process definition's identity links (RepositoryService.getIdentityLinksForProcessDefinition). Each given list is an exact set.

extensions.description: What the runtime's own reader (ProcessExtensionService, org.activiti.spring.process.model.Extension) made of the process's -extensions.json: the properties by name, the input/output mappings and the constants by element id. This is what the engine will use at run time (decision task constants such as _activiti_dmn_table_, mapping types, input and output sources), not what the file says.

properties.description: Key = property (variable) name -> expected properties of its VariableDefinition (name, type, required, value, description, displayName, display, analytics, ephemeral); the key must exist unless the value is {"$exists": false}.

mappings.description: Key = element id -> the listed properties of its ProcessVariablesMapping (use $size to count entries): mappingType (MAP_ALL, MAP_ALL_INPUTS, MAP_ALL_OUTPUTS or null), ephemeral, inputs and outputs (target name -> { type: VARIABLE | VALUE | JSONPATCH, value }). {"$exists": false} asserts there is no mapping for the element.

constants.description: Key = element id -> the exact constants of the element, name -> value (plain values or matchers). {"$exists": false} asserts there are none.

elements.description: Key = element id (flow node, sequence flow or data object, searched recursively through sub processes).

type.description: XML element name of the parsed element, e.g. userTask, serviceTask, boundaryEvent, sequenceFlow.
